definitions.explanation: Indicates that a task, process, or action has been fully completed. Commonly used in administrative, technical, and digital contexts as a status label.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{完了済|かんりょうず}みです。
⟦ダウンロード→ダウンロード：04725_daunroodo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{完了済|かんりょうず}みになっている。

⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{完了済|かんりょうず}みです⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ステップ→ステップ：11579_suteppu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The report submission is already completed, so please proceed to the next step.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{完了|かんりょう}→完了：02560_kanryou⟧ (completion) + {済|す}み (finished). Technically redundant since both ⟦{完了|かんりょう}→完了：02560_kanryou⟧ and {済|す}み convey completion, but the combination is standard in status labels and administrative language. Very common in digital interfaces, project management, and official documents.

Used as a no-adjective modifier: {完了済|かんりょうず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧ (completed procedures).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧{完了済|かんりょうず}み: procedures completed
- ⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧{完了済|かんりょうず}み: setup complete
- ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧{完了済|かんりょうず}み: inspection completed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{完了|かんりょう}→完了：02560_kanryou⟧: completion — the base word, sufficient on its own in many contexts
- {済|す}み: done; finished — shorter suffix form, also used alone as a status marker
- ⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧{済|す}み: processed — a similar compound indicating a specific action has been finished
